title: Bain Narjis ka tha aye Hassan Askari
body:
1 Bain nargis ka tha ae hasan askari, Mujhko bewa kiya ae hasan askari.
2 Beqabar is tarah haye kyun hogaye, Tumko kya hogaya ae hasan askari.
3 Ae imame zaman dekho wiraniyan, Tum pe londi fida ae hasan askari.
4 Pitte sar hai sab dekhiye uthke ab, Apke dilruba ae hasan askari.
<<DIVIDER>>
5 Woh sahqi kon the zeher yeh kyun diya, Kardiya ghar tabah ae hasan askari.
6 Mujhse sadme na yeh uth sakege kabhi, Mujhko lijiye bula ae hasan askari.
7 Kis tarah se shaha me jiyogi bhala, Hoke tumse juda ae hasan askari.
8 Qabr par apki baith kar katongi, Yeh randapa mera ae hasan askari.
<<DIVIDER>>
9 Kuch na qoufe Khuda haye zalim kiya, Raaj luta mera ae hasan askari.
